Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.qov_ph DILG OPINION No. 45 s. 2022 June 3, 2022 MR. PATERNO D. GREGORIO JR. HRMO Ill Municipality of Kalilangan Province of Bukidnon Dear Mr. Gregorio Jr.: This pertains to your letter dated 2 May 2022 requesting for legal opinion on the remuneration, benefits and salary of an acting Liga ng mga Barangay President in his six months tenure in lieu of the suspension of the Liga President. The antecedent facts presented are as follows: I. On 09 February 2022, the ABC President Neleonito B. Cabisay was issued a Six (6) months suspension from public office by the Sangguniang Bayan effective 09 February 2022 to 09 August 2022. 2. On the same date, 09 February 2022, the Liga ng mga Barangay Vice President Nestor L. Jumao-as was issued a certification by the DILG Municipal Operations Office, Kalilangan, Bukidnon, certifying the latter's temporary representation on behalf of the suspended Liga President as Ex-Officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan of Kalingan, Bukidnon. Hence, the request of the concerned HRMO for enlightenment on the remuneration, benefits and salary due to the Acting Liga ng mga Barangay President in his Six (6) months tenure in office. Two (2) DILG legal opinions, DILG Opinion No. 20 s. 2018 and DILG Opinion No. 19 s. 2019 were cited. Both opinions categorically stated that the Acting Liga President is entitled to the RATA of the position of the Liga President as ex-officio member of the sanggunian, but not to other remunerations. However, the Legal Opinion of the Liga ng mga Barangay No. 2020-004, contrary to the opinion of this Department, stated that the acting Liga ng mga Barangay President is entitled to the salaries and benefits accorded to said position, to wit: Upon the assumption and the exercise by the vice president of the duties and functions of the president, he shall be entitled to the salaries and benefits accorded to the said position. It is well to bear in mind that compensations correspond to the performance of the functions of a given office. Hence, in case of incapacity and/or vacancy, permanent or otherwise, in the office of the Liga chapter president, the annual exercise of the duties and functions of the said Office is necessarily to be borne by the Liga Chapter Vice President as a matter of duty. The assumption of the Liga ng mga Barangay Vice President as ex-officio member of "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

the Sanggunian is attached to the duty of her position as Liga ng mga Barangay Vice President. Since the nature of the position is in an ex-officio capacity, there is no additional remuneration or salary attached to the Liga ng mga Barangay President, except the RATA accorded to that ex-officio representation. Still, the salaries and other benefits received by the Liga ng mga Barangay President is from his position as Punong Barangay, the elective position he or she occupies. In this regard, we stand firm with our previous position. On whether the Liga ng mga Barangay opinion will prevail over the opinion of this Department, we opine in the negative. The Liga ng mga Barangay is an organization of barangays comprising the Republic of the Philippines. Though its formation is rooted in the Local Government Code on the mandate of formation of leagues in all levels of the local bureaucratic hierarchy, it is not a government institution. The purpose of its formation is to serve as venue for the barangays to articulate, ventilate and crystalize issues affecting barangay government administration and securing solutions and securing solutions to these issues through proper coordination among its members. Its opinion may be deemed proper for issues involving matters internal to the organization. The Department, on the other hand is a government agency with mandate under R.A. No. 6975 and delegated with general supervisory powers of the President over Local Governments pursuant to AO No. 267, s. 1992. Though its opinion is not controlling and is issued in an advisory capacity, it is most often accorded high respect by the judiciary in its decisions because the Department is guided with the mandate of ensuring local governments' compliance to existing laws and governmental policies; thus, it is most often accorded high respect by the judiciary in its decisions. The issue herein is entitlement to salary, benefits and other remuneration which is to be disbursed out of governmental funds. Thus, rendering an opinion thereon is not an act of control or encroachment to the internal matters of the Liga ng mga Barangay, and all the more not a violation of the local government's local autonomy. It is rendered to provide guidance to ensure compliance to financial and auditing policies of the government. In this particular issue, to avoid double compensation. The foregoing opinion is being issued without prejudice to contrary opinion/decisions/ruling by competent authorities and the court. We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: MARLT I GAN Undersec -ry for Local Gover OUSLG/MLI/LLLS-LRA b DIR. NEL M.
